_comment: Copy this to spotify_seed.json and fill it with your own listening data, then run `python -m radio.cli seed`. The real file is gitignored because it is a fingerprint of your taste. Format per row: [title, artist, m:ss]. Duration is optional but helps the resolver reject the wrong upload -- a nightcore edit or an hour-long loop will not match the length and gets skipped. Anything you leave empty is simply skipped; the station will still learn from scratch, it just starts colder.
_where_to_get_this: Top tracks: https://www.spotify.com -> your profile, or any Spotify stats site
Or ask an assistant with Spotify access to pull your top tracks and recently played
Or just type in forty songs you like. It genuinely does not need to be exhaustive.
